Detailed Description

Memory handle.

fipMemoryIO is a class that allows you to load / save images from a memory handle.

Version:
FreeImage 3
Author:
Hervé Drolon

DWORD  size_in_bytes = 0

The memory buffer has to be freed by the user when no longer in use.
